input_fields.name: target_name
input_fields.description: Desired case-neutral name and naming constraints.

input_fields.name: conflict_object_identity
input_fields.description: Target object identity plus existing conflicting object identity.

input_fields.name: naming_strategy
input_fields.description: One deterministic policy such as rename-target or choose-suffixed-name.

result_fields.name: naming_resolution
result_fields.description: Unique final name, target identity, conflict resolution, and optional call snippet.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when ownership or naming policy is unclear.

procedure: Resolve target/conflict ownership and enumerate names in declared scope.
Apply one naming strategy and choose one unique final name; preserve object identity and member relationships.
Emit final name and, when supported, one rename call such as RenameObject.Execute on target selection.
Return needs_manual_review when ownership or policy remains ambiguous.
rejection_rules: If the strategy's editable scope conflicts with the object its rename/suffix rule would change, return needs_manual_review; do not silently prioritize either field.
Reject ordinal-only identity, duplicate final name, or ambiguous owner.
Reject a strategy changing group membership/geometry.
Do not rename multiple objects or build a naming workflow.
